author: Spartemex
body:
Another PlugDJ event! This event will be any kind of music (that complies with the rules). We will have more themed events in the future, but not this time. Head on down to Avi's PlugDJ to register, or login to your existing account.

Make sure to look at the rules in the community description, and in Avicus' General Behavior section.  

The party starts at 6:30 EST, and has no end time. Hope to see you there!
